column1: # Decisions log — local index. Notion is canonical; this is a compact mirror.
# Why it exists: PRODUCT_SPEC.md is ~33,000 tokens and the Notion page is comparable.
# Reading either to check one decision is the single most expensive habit an agent can
# have in this project. All 103 decisions cost ~1,800 tokens here, and one decision
# Cite as [D-73]. Never restate the reasoning — it lives in Notion, and a copy drifts.
